RagShortTexts: The Visconti brandished the child-devouring Biscione viper, battling the della Torre for.

Variants.Content: Contesting dominion over Milan against the rival della Torre faction, the House of Visconti rallied behind Archbishop Ottone Visconti. Bearing the menacing Biscione—a viper devouring a child—they laid the groundwork for an enduring Lombard signoria built on unsparing statecraft.
Control over Saint Ambrose's basilica granted the Visconti immense spiritual revenue to hire mercenary crossbowmen and heavy cavalry.
